_about: Every colour the game draws with, as red, green, blue and opacity, 0 to 255.

screen_text._about: The words and panels on the screen.

UI_WHITE.about: white words and marks on the screen

UI_DARK.about: the dark backing behind bars, the map and the chosen cell, and dark words on a light one

BUBBLE_EDGE_COLOR.about: the edge round his speech bubble

UI_PANEL.about: the see-through dark backing of the panel at the top left and of the sack

UI_RED.about: red on the screen: a need run out, low stamina, an animal near the end of its health, a throw wound up full

UI_GREEN.about: green words in the menus: good news, what is growing, the outfit chosen

UI_YELLOW.about: yellow on the screen: titles and help lines, what is chosen, the throw's wind-up bar and the arrowhead over what he aims at

UI_ORANGE.about: orange on the screen: titles, warnings, a need he lacks, an animal down to half its health

UI_BRUISE.about: the bruised end of the stamina bar

meadow_and_prosio._about: Prosio, the ground, plants, and the colours used all over.

COLOR_OUTSIDE.about: the ground beyond the meadow, under the fog

COLOR_TUFT.about: tufts of grass, and the stalks of flowers

COLOR_FERN.about: ferns and the low bushes under the forest trees

COLOR_FENCE.about: a fence's wood, though nothing is drawn with it at present (fences use PLANK_DARK and COLOR_PLANK)

COLOR_SKIN.about: his skin, which tans towards HIDE_TAN as his hide toughens

COLOR_SKIN_DARK.about: his snout, the insides of his ears and his belly button

COLOR_BLUSH.about: a blush, though nothing is drawn with it at present (his cheeks use ANIMAL_BLUSH)

COLOR_NOSTRIL.about: his nostrils and his open mouth

COLOR_SHIRT.about: the explorer's jacket, and the clasp of his pack

COLOR_HEADBAND.about: his red head cloth and kerchief, and the bands of the straw hat and the top hat

COLOR_HOOF.about: his hooves and eyebrows, and dark bands on wooden things such as the churn's hoops

COLOR_WHITE.about: a warm white used all over: the shine in eyes, eggs, milk, sparks, the mill on the map and white bits of clothes

COLOR_STAR.about: stars and sparkles: a knock, a fall, a thing made

COLOR_GOLD.about: gold: buckles and clasps, the crown, the monocle, earrings and the nose ring

COLOR_DUST.about: dust kicked up by landings, falls and bumps

COLOR_SWEAT.about: drops of sweat when he strains

COLOR_CRUMB.about: crumbs when he eats something that is not a dish

COLOR_HEART.about: the heart that thumps above him, the hearts over a licking goat, and the crown's jewel

COLOR_LEAF.about: leaves: the crowns of broadleaf and apple trees, and leaves on crops and fallen branches

COLOR_LEAF_DARK.about: darker leaves, mixed in with COLOR_LEAF, and a cabbage's outer leaves

COLOR_LEAF_LIGHT.about: lighter leaves, mixed in with COLOR_LEAF, and bits of leaf when a crop is picked or nibbled

COLOR_TRUNK.about: bark and dark wood: tree trunks, stems, firewood, the chopping block and the scarecrow's pole

COLOR_ROCK.about: stone: pebbles, the footings of the oven and the mill, the stones round the fire

COLOR_ROCK_LIGHT.about: lighter stone, mixed in with COLOR_ROCK, and the spear's point

COLOR_PLANK.about: pale wood: snapped branches, the top of the chopping block, the churn, the larder, parts of fences and the workbench

FLOWER_COLORS.about: the meadow's flowers, each one of these

BERRY_COLOR.about: ripe berries (they ripen from green to this), and bushes on the map

WHEAT.about: ripe wheat (it ripens from green to this)

UNRIPE_GREEN.about: an unripe apple, which reddens to APPLE_RED as it ripens

HEALTH_GOOD.about: the bar over an animal while it has more than half its health

ANIMAL_INK.about: dark marks on the animals and the scarecrow: eyes, brows, noses, beards, the crosses of a dead one

ANIMAL_BLUSH.about: pink: his rosy cheeks, the fox's, and a rabbit's ears and nose

TURKEY_BRONZE.about: a turkey's bronze body, and every other tail feather

TURKEY_DARK.about: a turkey's darker breast, thighs and wings, and the bands on its tail feathers

TURKEY_TIP.about: the pale tips of a turkey's feathers and wings, and the feathers that fly off it

TURKEY_SKIN.about: a turkey's bare blue neck and head

TURKEY_RED.about: a turkey's red wattle and snood

BEAK.about: beaks: the turkey's and the crow's

GOAT_PATCH.about: a goat's darker patches and beard

BILLY_DARK.about: the billy goat's darker patches and beard

GOAT_PINK.about: a goat's nose and the insides of its ears

UDDER_PINK.about: A goat: a barrel of a body on four thin legs, a short perky tail, floppy ears, a little beard and horns. The billy goat is bigger and brown, with a long beard and great curling horns. Held, one hind leg runs to Prosio's hand.

HIDE_TAN.about: his skin with the toughest hide: it tans towards this as his hide toughens

SALT_PINK.about: rock salt, and the salt rocks on the map

needs_and_body._about: His needs and the parts of his body, on the screen and in the menus.

NUTRIENT_COLOR.about: The colour of each in the bar of what a food is made of, as in the panel of what he is made of.

NEED_POWER.about: the bars of what each trait is worth, on the BODY page

NEED_SILLY.about: a need's bar on the panel when he has too much of it

MUSCLE_RED.about: muscle: its part of what he is made of, and a muscle built past ordinary on the BODY page

PART_COLOR.about: the colour of each part of him, in the bar of what he is made of and on the BODY page

NEED_BAR.about: Each need's bar, when all is well.

buildings_and_food._about: The oven, the fire, the mill, food and the sack.

ITEM_COLOR.about: The colour of each, for the thing in his hoof as he picks it up.

BRICK.about: the oven's bricks, and the oven on the map

BRICK_LINE.about: the lines between the oven's bricks

FLAME.about: flames, and the fire on the map

FLAME_HOT.about: every other flame: the hot yellow ones

STEEL.about: steel: the cleaver by the fire and the saw at the workbench

CRUST.about: golden pie crust, and a made thing an animal carries off in its mouth

CRUST_DARK.about: darker crust: the rim of a mushroom pie, the slashes on a loaf

SACK_BOX.about: the boxes things sit in, in the sack and the larder

MILL_WALL.about: the mill's walls, and the flour waiting there

clothes_and_map._about: Prosio's clothes and hair, and the map.

MAP_FOG.about: the map where he has not been yet

MAP_HILLS.about: the goat hills on the map

MAP_PATH.about: the paths and his home on the map

MAP_SOIL.about: fields of crops other than wheat on the map

HAT_BLACK.about: the top hat and the sunglasses

TSHIRT.about: the red T-shirt, and the scarecrow's shirt

SAILOR.about: white cloth: the sailor top, the white shirt, the chef's jacket and the apron

NAVY.about: the sailor top's collar and hem, and the print on the computer tee

BOOT.about: the brown boots, and the leather flying cap

LEATHER.about: black leather: the jacket, the trousers, the knee boots, the pirate top and the outside of the cape

TEE_BLACK.about: the band tee and the turtleneck

CAPE_RED.about: the inside and collar of the cape, the tie and the bow tie

SOLE.about: the soles of the knee boots

LEG_COLOR.about: the colour of each kind of trousers or skirt

HONEY_GOLD.about: honeycomb, and the hives on the map

PLANK_DARK.about: darker wood: fences and gates, the workbench, the larder, branches and the spear's shaft

outlines_and_shadows._about: The dark outlines, and the shadows.

OUTLINE_COLOR.about: Dark cartoon outlines around solid shapes, about one pixel wide.

SHADOW_INK.about: how much of the light a shadow lets through
